notes: Route r1 (OO, construction & testing canon): 105 elements, 103 covered by >=1 work, 2 explicit gaps (multiton, servant). 13 memberships reuse exact corpus ids (gof anchors the 23 GoF patterns plus delegation/double-dispatch/hook-operations provenance; iglberger supplies the modern C++ revisit; grenningtdd claims the embedded testing lens; meyerseffcpp/mcconnell/martincleanarch/fowlerref add verified coverage that spared three hard-to-verify papers). 36 new works: 29 verified against live primary pages this session, 7 unverified with UNRESOLVED naming the soft field (Wiley and ACM DL returned 403 to fetches; gotw.ca failed TLS; martinfowler.com's spec.pdf is password-protected). Corrections to the seed list: Role Object is in PLoPD4 (confirmed live via InformIT ToC), not PLoPD3; PLoPD3's verified publication year is 1997 (often cited 1998); PLoPD1/2/5 not needed by this route. Seed 'bloch' (2006 API paper) membership was considered and rejected: it teaches API design generally but does not define any route element at catalog grade; Effective Java 3rd ed. added instead. Hook-method is covered by GoF's named 'hook operations' treatment in Template Method rather than by adding Pree's Meta Patterns (ECOOP 1994) unverified. Cunningham CHECKS and Grand's Patterns in Java were not needed — every element they would cover is already reached by stronger works. One living-catalog node each for Refactoring.Guru (22 GoF survey) and SourceMaking (sole catalog-grade Private Class Data source).
